boon.isekai_mahou.void_lady.desc.3: night vision, calm Endermen and safer falls
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.greet.0: Who dares burn their own blood to call me?
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.greet.1: Ahh... the scent of ash and ambition. Speak, mortal.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.greet.2: The embers brought me here. Make it brief.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.demand.0: Power is not given. It is bought. This is my price.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.demand.1: Feed my fire and I shall feed yours.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.accept.0: Then it is done. Do not keep me waiting.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.accept.1: The contract burns. Fulfill it before it fades.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.sealed.0: The pact is sealed in flame. Burn in my name!
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.sealed.1: You have true fire. Return when you crave more.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.taunt.0: I can feel the chill of your fear from here.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.taunt.1: This chalk will not hold me forever.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.taunt.3: I have burned kingdoms for less.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.waiting.0: Did you bring my tribute, or merely come to warm yourself?
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.missing.0: This is an insult. Bring ALL of it.
You did not call me, worm. Out of my light.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.enrage.0: ENOUGH! I will reduce everything to ash!
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.wild.0: Free of the circle, free to burn!
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.freed_ref: Refuse?! Then pay with your flesh!
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.freed_cir: The circle is broken! Now I set the price!
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.freed_tim: Time is up. And so are you.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.freed_fai: You failed me? No one fails me twice.
patron.isekai_mahou.ember_lord.freed_imp: I do not wait on dithering mortals!
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.epithet: Queen of the Silence Between Stars
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.greet.0: Shhh... you heard the void calling, and you answered.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.greet.1: So small, so full of want. How curious.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.greet.2: You opened a door you cannot close, child.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.demand.0: Every secret of the void has a price. This is yours.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.demand.1: Give me something you cannot take back.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.accept.1: Go. The stars are counting your steps.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.sealed.0: Now part of the void lives in you. Do not fear the dark.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.sealed.1: Pact sealed. Whisper my name and I will hear.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.taunt.0: The candles tremble. So do you.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.taunt.1: How long until the chalk fades?
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.taunt.2: I have seen the end of worlds larger than this.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.waiting.0: You returned. Did you bring what I asked?
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.missing.0: Incomplete. The void accepts no halves.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.stranger.0: You are not the one who called me. Look away.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.enrage.0: I will erase you from the stars!
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.wild.0: Which star left the door open?
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.freed_refu: You refused the void? Then the void comes to you.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.freed_time: Your time has run out, little one.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.freed_fail: Empty promises deserve an empty end.
patron.isekai_mahou.void_lady.freed_impa: Indecision is a kind of refusal.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.greet.0: Glub... who dragged the King from the sea floor?
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.greet.1: The tide brought me. The tide always collects.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.greet.2: Kneel before the drowned throne, landwalker.
The ocean gives and the ocean takes. Now, you give.
A king's bargain! Do not dishonor me.
The tide waits... but not forever.
Pact sealed! The waters now know your name.
You have the respect of the drowned throne.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.taunt.0: This dry air makes me itch.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.taunt.1: My drowned subjects long for company.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.taunt.2: The chalk will wash away with the next rain...
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.taunt.3: I have sunk whole fleets for less.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.waiting: The King waits. The King hates waiting.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.missing: This barely fills a bucket! Bring the rest.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.strange: You did not summon me, little fish. Begone.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.wild.0: Dry land! How dreadful. Someone will pay for this.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.freed_c: The circle cracked! The tide rises!
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.freed_t: The tide has turned. Against you.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.freed_f: Unpaid debt is collected in blood.
patron.isekai_mahou.drowned_king.freed_i: The King waits for no one!
